name: Area-based Pixel Kernel
aliases: Noyau de Pixel basé sur l’aire (Area-based Pixel Kernel)
Noyau d’interpolation sur l’aire des pixels
definition: A reconstruction kernel that interprets a projection line (θ, ρ) as a thick line of thickness dρ, bounded by (θ, ρ - dρ/2) and (θ, ρ + dρ/2). It assigns contribution to pixels proportional to the common area between the pixel and the thick line, solving the issue where Dirac/B-Spline kernels fail to reconstruct pixels in subsampling and linear kernels do not exploit all data in oversampling.
